_doc: Graphics-card apps and PC-brand update tools. DayZero detects the GPU vendor (PCI vendor id) and the
brand (BIOS manufacturer), then installs the matching official app.
winget:  package id (checked against winget-pkgs on 2026-11-12, re-checked at install time).
msstore: Microsoft Store id (installed with winget from the msstore source).
page:    official download page, used when the vendor does not publish the app through winget.
DayZero never downloads installers from unofficial mirrors; it shows a link on the summary
screen instead. Windows Update still installs a working graphics driver in the meantime.
PC-brand tools are offered on the review screen (ticked) when the brand is recognised; never in a VM.

gpuApps.name: NVIDIA App
gpuApps.what: NVIDIA's driver and game-settings app (GeForce Game Ready drivers, overlay, recording).

gpuApps.name: AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition
gpuApps.what: AMD's Radeon driver and settings app. The page offers AMD's auto-detect installer.

gpuApps.name: Intel Driver & Support Assistant
gpuApps.what: Keeps Intel graphics, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth drivers up to date.

oemTools.name: Dell Command | Update
oemTools.what: Dell's BIOS, firmware and driver updater.

oemTools.name: Lenovo Vantage
oemTools.what: Lenovo's driver, BIOS and settings app.

oemTools.name: HP Support Assistant
oemTools.what: HP's driver, BIOS and support app.

oemTools.name: MyASUS
oemTools.what: ASUS's driver, BIOS and settings app.
